title: Dimethoxypropane Dehydration
author: Alex Rajewski
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rjud4nw

steps.title: Prepare acidified DMP solution
steps.instruction: Make an acidified dimethoxypropane (DMP) solution by mixing DMP with concentrated HCl at a ratio of 1 drop HCl per 100 mL DMP; prepare enough solution to equal roughly six times the volume of tissue to be fixed, scaling linearly as needed.

steps.title: First DMP dehydration incubation
steps.instruction: After discarding the fixative or ethanol, add three volumes of the acidified DMP solution for every volume of tissue, then incubate at room temperature for 15–30 minutes with occasional gentle shaking.

steps.title: Second DMP dehydration incubation
steps.instruction: Pour off the reacted DMP solution, replace it with the same volume of fresh acidified DMP solution, and incubate again at room temperature for 15–30 minutes with occasional gentle shaking.

steps.title: Acetone wash and replacement
steps.instruction: Remove the reacted DMP solution, add an equal volume of extra‑dry acetone, and over the course of 15 minutes repeatedly pour off and replace the acetone 1–2 additional times to wash away methanol produced in the dehydration reaction.

substeps.instruction: Pour off the reacted DMP solution.
Add an equal volume of extra‑dry acetone.
For 15 minutes, repeat: pour off acetone and replace with fresh extra‑dry acetone 1–2 times.

steps.title: Acetone‑Histoclear incubation
steps.instruction: Discard the acetone, add a 1:1 mixture of acetone and Histoclear (ratio approximate; prepare while pouring into the vial), and incubate at room temperature for several hours; Citrisolv may substitute for Histoclear, though not tested with xylene.

steps.title: Histoclear wash and paraffin infiltration
steps.instruction: Remove the Histoclear:acetone mixture, replace with enough pure Histoclear to just cover the tissue, fill the remainder of the scintillation vial with paraffin chips, and place the vial at 60 °C overnight.

substeps.instruction: Add pure Histoclear until the tissue is just barely covered.
Add paraffin chips to fill the vial.

steps.title: Paraffin infiltration and final changes
steps.instruction: The following morning, replace the paraffin:Histoclear mixture with melted paraffin; over the next two days, change the paraffin 2–3 times per day until the tissue is ready for molding or block preparation.

substeps.instruction: Replace the paraffin:Histoclear mixture with melted paraffin.
For the next two days, change the paraffin 2–3 times per day until ready for block making.
